verdict.rationale: Bento documents a beginner DNS onboarding guide in which you add DNS records to authenticate your sending domain so Bento can send on your behalf, and its docs hub calls out domain authentication. That is first-party guided DNS setup. However, the evidence never names SPF, DKIM or DMARC alignment, and never describes an in-product verification or status check. Missing for 10: explicit SPF/DKIM/DMARC record coverage and alignment, a documented DNS verification step, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification

citations.quote: To get your emails delivered reliably, you need to add a few DNS records for your domain. These records authenticate your domain and allow Bento to send email on your behalf.
Connect your app, authenticate your sending domain, and send your first email.
